_comment: Machine-readable model registry. Updated by training scripts. Read by both Streamlit apps.

k100s2_v1.architecture: Conv1D k100(s2) → Conv1D k25(s2) → Conv1D k11 → Conv1D k3 → Dense 256 → Dense 64 → Dense 250
k100s2_v1.description: Primary single-layer model. Four Conv1D layers with strided kernels (k=100 stride 2, k=25 stride 2, k=11, k=3) compress the 250-bin input before two Dense layers. Trained on TrackNet10 Ca-48 150 MeV/n source with MAE loss over bins 50–240. Achieves dose errors under 20% on most single-layer PHITS cases.

transfer_mlp.description: Transfer MLP head for multilayer layer-2 inference. The entire k100s2_v1 backbone is frozen; only the 32K-parameter MLP head (Dense 64 → Dense 250) is trained. Used in the primary multilayer mode where TrackNet10 is fed as the layer-2 source and the amplitude factor from layer-1 is applied to the output. Achieves dose error −28% to +18% across all 6 multilayer PHITS cases.

v_concrete25.architecture: Conv1D k100(s2) → k25(s2) → k11 → k3 → Dense 256 → Dense 64 → Dense 250
v_concrete25.training_source: Piecewise fit to Concrete 25cm PHITS output
v_concrete25.description: k100s2 variant trained using a piecewise spectral fit to the Concrete 25cm PHITS output as the source spectrum instead of TrackNet10. Tested as a source-matched layer-2 model in bi-model multilayer — showed no improvement over baseline.

v_steel27.architecture: Conv1D k100(s2) → k25(s2) → k11 → k3 → Dense 256 → Dense 64 → Dense 250
v_steel27.training_source: Piecewise fit to Steel 27cm PHITS output
v_steel27.description: k100s2 variant trained on a piecewise fit to the Steel 27cm PHITS output. Same bi-model experiment as v_concrete25 — showed no measurable improvement.

v_bpe25.architecture: Conv1D k100(s2) → k25(s2) → k11 → k3 → Dense 256 → Dense 64 → Dense 250
v_bpe25.training_source: Piecewise fit to BPE 25cm PHITS output
v_bpe25.description: k100s2 variant trained on a piecewise fit to the BPE 25cm PHITS output.

transfer_learned.description: First transfer head attempt: a single Dense(250) linear layer on top of the frozen k100s2_v1 output. Trained on piecewise concrete25 source spectra. Validation MAE plateaued at 0.173 — same as baseline. The linear head lacked capacity to correct spectral shape distortions.

transfer_concrete45_mlp.training_source: Piecewise fit to Concrete 45cm PHITS output
transfer_concrete45_mlp.description: MLP transfer head trained with a piecewise fit to the Concrete 45cm PHITS output as source. Improved val MAE to 0.150 (from 0.173) but worsened all inference cases. Root cause: head is trained on piecewise-approximated spectra; at inference it sees the actual CNN layer-1 output, which has a different distribution.

transfer_conv_head.architecture: Frozen k100s2_v1 conv backbone → Conv1D(50,k50) → Conv1D(10,k10,s2) → Flatten → Dense 250
transfer_conv_head.training_source: Actual CNN layer-1 predictions (15 source spectra)
transfer_conv_head.description: Conv1D transfer head trained on actual k100s2_v1 layer-1 outputs (Concrete/Steel/BPE at 5 thicknesses each). Head attaches after the frozen Conv1D_3 layer. Best val MAE of 0.046 but still worsened all 5 multilayer inference cases — the amplitude error from the a-factor is the dominant source of error, not the spectral shape.

tracknet10-original.architecture: Conv1D k3 → Conv1D k3 → MaxPool → Flatten(8000) → Dense 512 → Dense 250
tracknet10-original.description: Original TrackNet10 surrogate model (~9× more parameters than k100s2_v1). Two Conv1D layers with small kernels (k=3) followed by a large Dense(512) layer. Trained with MSE loss. Superseded by k100s2_v1 which achieves lower dose error with far fewer parameters.

piecewise6.architecture: Conv1D k3 → Conv1D k3 → MaxPool → Flatten(8000) → Dense 512 → Dense 250
piecewise6.description: TrackNet10-architecture model trained on the piecewise6 random source ensemble (smoothly-varying spectra from triply-broken power law and exponential components) rather than a fixed beam. Archived — piecewise training improved source diversity but the architecture was later replaced by k100s2.

piecewise6-offset-1.1.architecture: Conv1D k3 → Conv1D k3 → MaxPool → Flatten(8000) → Dense 512 → Dense 250
piecewise6-offset-1.1.description: Piecewise6 model with the noise amplitude σ(E) scaled up by 1.1×. Part of a systematic study of noise level sensitivity in the training source.

piecewise6-offset-1.2.architecture: Conv1D k3 → Conv1D k3 → MaxPool → Flatten(8000) → Dense 512 → Dense 250
piecewise6-offset-1.2.description: Piecewise6 + noise offset ×1.2. Noise sensitivity study variant.

piecewise6-offset-1.3.architecture: Conv1D k3 → Conv1D k3 → MaxPool → Flatten(8000) → Dense 512 → Dense 250

piecewise6-offset-1.4.architecture: Conv1D k3 → Conv1D k3 → MaxPool → Flatten(8000) → Dense 512 → Dense 250
piecewise6-offset-1.4.description: Piecewise6 + noise offset ×1.4. Highest noise level tested in this series.

k11-k3-d256-d128-mse.architecture: Conv1D k11 → Conv1D k3 → Dense 256 → Dense 128 → Dense 250
k11-k3-d256-d128-mse.description: Two-Conv1D architecture with larger kernels (k=11, k=3) and a wider Dense layer (256→128). Archived — intermediate step toward the final k100s2 architecture.

k25-k11-k3-mae.architecture: Conv1D k25 → Conv1D k11 → Conv1D k3 → Dense 256 → Dense 64 → Dense 250
k25-k11-k3-mae.description: Three-Conv1D architecture with increasing receptive field (k25→k11→k3). First model to use MAE loss instead of MSE. Predecessor to k100s2_v1.

k25-k11-k3-mse.architecture: Conv1D k25 → Conv1D k11 → Conv1D k3 → Dense 256 → Dense 64 → Dense 250
k25-k11-k3-mse.description: Same three-Conv1D architecture as k25-k11-k3-mae but trained with MSE. Included for loss function comparison.

k25-k11-k3-mae-scale0005.architecture: Conv1D k25 → Conv1D k11 → Conv1D k3 → Dense 256 → Dense 64 → Dense 250
k25-k11-k3-mae-scale0005.description: k25 architecture with input_scale=0.0005 (thickness and density scaled by 0.0005 instead of 0.001). Input scaling sensitivity study.

k25-k11-k3-mae-scale01.architecture: Conv1D k25 → Conv1D k11 → Conv1D k3 → Dense 256 → Dense 64 → Dense 250
k25-k11-k3-mae-scale01.description: k25 architecture with input_scale=0.1. One of several input scaling experiments.

k25-k11-k3-mae-bins240.architecture: Conv1D k25 → Conv1D k11 → Conv1D k3 → Dense 256 → Dense 64 → Dense 250
k25-k11-k3-mae-bins240.description: k25 architecture trained with loss over bins 0–240 (including low-energy region). Compared against the bins 50–240 variant.

k25-k11-k3-mae-bins50-240.architecture: Conv1D k25 → Conv1D k11 → Conv1D k3 → Dense 256 → Dense 64 → Dense 250
k25-k11-k3-mae-bins50-240.description: k25 architecture with loss focused on bins 50–240 (excluding thermal region below 50 MeV). This bin range was carried forward into k100s2_v1.

k51-k11-k3-mae-s1-bins50-240.architecture: Conv1D k51(s1) → Conv1D k11 → Conv1D k3 → Dense 256 → Dense 64 → Dense 250
k51-k11-k3-mae-s1-bins50-240.description: Wider kernel variant: k51 stride-1 first layer (1.13M params). Achieved val MAE=0.0827 but uses ~2.4× more parameters than k100s2_v1 for similar performance. Archived in favour of k100s2 which uses stride-2 to reduce parameter count.

k51-k11-k3-mae-s2-bins50-240.architecture: Conv1D k51(s2) → Conv1D k11 → Conv1D k3 → Dense 256 → Dense 64 → Dense 250
k51-k11-k3-mae-s2-bins50-240.description: k51 with stride=2 to reduce parameters to 624K. Val MAE=0.0967. Motivated the move to k100 strided kernels in k100s2_v1.
